title: External validation of NSGA-II electrode selection for EEG-based detection of mild cognitive impairment (code and results)
description: Code, results and manuscript sources for a preregistered replication and external validation of NSGA-II electrode selection for EEG-based detection of mild cognitive impairment (Aljalal et al., 2024). Preregistration: https://osf.io/4enh8
